# MAking greek characters:

make_param_label <- function(code) {
  greek_map <- list("m" = "μ", "s" = "σ", "b" = "β", "l" = "λ")

  greek <- greek_map[[substr(code, 1, 1)]]
  subscript <- substr(code, 2, nchar(code))

  if (is.null(greek)) {
    # fallback: just return code as-is
    return(as_paragraph(as_chunk(code)))
  }

  as_paragraph(
    as_chunk(greek),
    as_chunk(subscript, props = fp_text(vertical.align = "subscript"))
  )
}

format_numbers <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ case_when(
      . > 10 ~ formatC(., format = "f", big.mark = ",", digits = 0),
      . <= 10 & . == floor(.) ~ formatC(., format = "f", digits = 0),
      . <= 10 ~ formatC(., format = "f", digits = 3),
      TRUE ~ as.character(.)
    )))
}


make_ft <- function(data, table_title = NULL) {

  ft <- flextable(data)

  # Set the lower-level column labels
  ft <- set_header_labels(
    ft,
    Harvest_Estimates = "Estimate",
    Harvest_SD = "SD",
    Harvest_CI = "95% CI",
    Release_Estimates = "Estimate",
    Release_SD = "SD",
    Release_CI = "95% CI",
    Rel_Mort_Rate = "Rel. mort. rate",
    Mean_wt_lbs = "Mean wt. lbs.",
    TM_Estimates = "Estimate",
    TM_SD = "SD",
    TM_CI = "95% CI"
  )

  # Add grouped header row
  ft <- add_header_row(
    ft,
    values = c(
      "Year",
      "User",
      "Harvest",
      "Releases",
      "Rel. mort. rate",
      "Mean wt. lbs.",
      "Total mortality (lbs. biomass)"
    ),
    colwidths = c(1, 1, 3, 3, 1, 1, 3)
  )

  # Vertically merge the single-column headings
  ft <- merge_v(
    ft,
    j = c("Year", "User", "Rel_Mort_Rate", "Mean_wt_lbs"),
    part = "header"
  )

  # Add table title on first page only
  if (!is.null(table_title)) {
    ft <- add_header_row(
      ft,
      values = table_title,
      colwidths = ncol(data)
    )
  }

  # Existing formatting
  ft <- ft %>%
    font(fontname = "Times New Roman", part = "all") %>%
    fontsize(size = 10, part = "header") %>%
    fontsize(size = 9, part = "body") %>%
    align(align = "center", part = "all") %>%
    set_table_properties(layout = "fixed") %>%
    line_spacing(space = 0.5, part = "body") %>%
    height_all(height = 0.10) %>%
    width(j = c(1:2, 4, 7, 9:10, 12), width = 0.53) %>%
    width(j = c(3, 6, 11), width = 0.70) %>%
    width(j = c(5, 8, 13), width = 1.06) %>%
    border_remove() %>%
    border_remove() %>%
    hline_top(
      border = officer::fp_border(color = "black", width = 0.5),
      part = "header"
    ) %>%
    hline(
      i = 1,
      border = officer::fp_border(color = "black", width = 0.5),
      part = "header"
    ) %>%
    hline(
      i = 2,
      j = c(3:5, 6:8, 11:13),
      border = officer::fp_border(color = "black", width = 0.5),
      part = "header"
    ) %>%
    hline_bottom(
      border = officer::fp_border(color = "black", width = 0.5),
      part = "body"
    ) %>%
    hline_bottom( border = officer::fp_border(color = "black", width = 0.5),
                  part = "header") %>%
    
    paginate(init = FALSE, hdr_ftr = TRUE)

  ft
}



make_appendix_table <- function(data,
                                appendix,
                                first_page_rows = 18,
                                other_page_rows = 25,
                                table_title = NULL) {

  n <- nrow(data)

  # Determine number of pages
  remaining <- max(0, n - first_page_rows)

  n_pages <- 1 + ceiling(remaining / other_page_rows)

  for (i in seq_len(n_pages)) {

    if (i == 1) {
      first_row <- 1
      last_row <- min(first_page_rows, n)

    } else {
      first_row <- first_page_rows +
        (i - 2) * other_page_rows + 1

      last_row <- min(
        first_row + other_page_rows - 1,
        n
      )

      # Continuation caption: 11 pt, normal, indented
      cat(
        paste0(
          '<w:p>',
            '<w:pPr>',
              '<w:ind w:left="360"/>',
              '<w:jc w:val="left"/>',
            '</w:pPr>',
            '<w:r>',
              '<w:rPr>',
                '<w:rFonts w:ascii="Times New Roman" w:hAnsi="Times New Roman"/>',
                '<w:sz w:val="22"/>',
              '</w:rPr>',
              '<w:t>',
                appendix, '.–Page ', i, ' of ', n_pages, '.',
              '</w:t>',
            '</w:r>',
          '</w:p>'
        )
      )
    }

    page_data <- data[first_row:last_row, ]

    # Format this page's table
    page_ft <- make_ft(
      page_data,
 #     table_title = if (i == 1) table_title else NULL
      table_title = table_title
    )

    # Render the flextable
    child <- knitr::knit_child(
      text = c(
        "```{r}",
        "page_ft",
        "```"
      ),
      envir = environment(),
      quiet = TRUE
    )

    cat(child)

    # Continuation notice and page break
    if (i < n_pages) {

      # Centered, 9 pt continuation notice
      cat(
        paste0(
          '<w:p>',
            '<w:pPr>',
              '<w:jc w:val="center"/>',
            '</w:pPr>',
            '<w:r>',
              '<w:rPr>',
                '<w:rFonts w:ascii="Times New Roman" w:hAnsi="Times New Roman"/>',
                '<w:sz w:val="18"/>',
              '</w:rPr>',
              '<w:t>-continued-</w:t>',
            '</w:r>',
          '</w:p>'
        )
      )

      cat("\\newpage\n\n")
    }
  }

  invisible(NULL)
}

::: {custom-style="Caption"}
Appendix D`r AT_N2`.`r AT_N`.—Estimates of black rockfish harvests and releases in numbers of fish, release mortality rate (Rel. mort. rate), mean weight, and total mortality in pounds of biomass by year and user group for the `r area_names[AT_N]` commercial fisheries management unit (CFMU) 1977 - `r end_yr`. User "gui" indicates guided trips while "pri" indicates unguided trips. SD indicates standard deviation and 95% CI indicates 95% credibility intervals from the Bayesian model output. The release mortality rate is the proportion of released fish expected to die after release.  
```{r, results='asis'}
make_appendix_table(
  data = black_ci,
  appendix = paste0("Appendix D",AT_N2,".",AT_N),
  first_page_rows = first_page_rows,
  other_page_rows = other_page_rows,
  table_title = paste0(area_names[AT_N]," black rockfish")
)

AT_N <- AT_N + 1
```

```{r, echo = FALSE}
# YELLOWEYE
ye <- readxl::read_xlsx(paste0("RF_Sport_Removals_FINAL_thru",end_yr,".xlsx"), 
#ye <- readxl::read_xlsx(paste0("RF_Sport_Removals_RepV.xlsx"), 
                       sheet = "Yelloweye") %>% 
  clean_names() %>% filter(rowSums(is.na(.)) < ncol(.)) %>%
  mutate(p_mort_r = round(p_mort_r,3),
         mort_rate = round(mort_rate,3),
         year = as.factor(year),
         user = ifelse(user == "guided","gui",
                       ifelse(user == "unguided","pri","All"))) 

ye <- format_numbers(ye)

ye <- ye %>%
  mutate(r_lo95 = ifelse(as.numeric(gsub(",", "", r_lo95)) <= 10,
                         round(as.numeric(r_lo95),0),
                         r_lo95),
         #r_hi95 = round(as.numeric(r_hi95),0),
         rm_lo95 = ifelse(as.numeric(gsub(",", "", rm_lo95)) <= 10,
                         round(as.numeric(rm_lo95),0),
                         rm_lo95),
         rm_hi95 = ifelse(as.numeric(gsub(",", "", rm_hi95)) <= 10,
                         round(as.numeric(rm_lo95),0),
                         rm_hi95),
         release_morts = round(as.numeric(release_morts),0),
         'H. 95% CI' = paste0(h_lo95, " - ", h_hi95),
         'R. 95% CI' = paste0(r_lo95, " - ", r_hi95),
         'RM. 95% CI' = paste0(rm_lo95, " - ", rm_hi95),
         'TM. 95% CI' = paste0(m_lo95, " - ", m_hi95)
         ) %>%
select(Year = year, User = user, area, region,
       Harvest_Estimates = harvests,
       Harvest_SD = sd_h,
       Harvest_CI = `H. 95% CI`,
       Release_Estimates = releases,
       Release_SD = sd_r,
       Release_CI = `R. 95% CI`,
       Rel_Mort_Rate = mort_rate,
       Mean_wt_lbs = wt,
       TM_Estimates = mort_lbs,
       TM_SD = sd_m,
       TM_CI = `TM. 95% CI`)

area_codes <- unique(ye$area)

ye %>% filter(area == "CI" & User != "All") %>%
  select(-region, -area)-> ye_ci
ye %>% filter(area == "NG" & User != "All") %>%
  select(-region, -area)-> ye_ng
ye %>% filter(area == "PWSI" & User != "All") %>%
  select(-region, -area)-> ye_pwsi
ye %>% filter(area == "PWSO" & User != "All") %>%
  select(-region, -area)-> ye_pwso

ye %>% filter(area == "BSAI" & User != "All") %>%
  select(-region, -area)-> ye_bsai
ye %>% filter(area == "SOKO2SAP" & User != "All") %>%
  select(-region, -area)-> ye_soko
ye %>% filter(area == "WKMA" & User != "All") %>%
  select(-region, -area)-> ye_wkma
ye %>% filter(area == "AFOGNAK" & User != "All") %>%
  select(-region, -area)-> ye_afog
ye %>% filter(area == "EASTSIDE" & User != "All") %>%
  select(-region, -area)-> ye_eastside
ye %>% filter(area == "NORTHEAST" & User != "All") %>%
  select(-region, -area)-> ye_northeast

ye %>% filter(area == "CSEO" & User != "All") %>%
  select(-region, -area)-> ye_cseo
ye %>% filter(area == "EWYKT" & User != "All") %>%
  select(-region, -area)-> ye_ewykt
ye %>% filter(area == "NSEI" & User != "All") %>%
  select(-region, -area)-> ye_nsei
ye %>% filter(area == "NSEO" & User != "All") %>%
  select(-region, -area)-> ye_nseo
ye %>% filter(area == "SSEI" & User != "All") %>%
  select(-region, -area)-> ye_ssei
ye %>% filter(area == "SSEO" & User != "All") %>%
  select(-region, -area)-> ye_sseo

AT_N <- 1
AT_N2 <- AT_N2 + 1
```

```{r, echo = FALSE}
# SLOPE
slope <- readxl::read_xlsx(paste0("RF_Sport_Removals_FINAL_thru",end_yr,".xlsx"), 
#slope <- readxl::read_xlsx(paste0("RF_Sport_Removals_RepV.xlsx"), 
                       sheet = "Slope") %>% 
  clean_names() %>% filter(rowSums(is.na(.)) < ncol(.)) %>%
  mutate(p_mort_r = round(p_mort_r,3),
         mort_rate = round(mort_rate,3),
         year = as.factor(year),
         user = ifelse(user == "guided","gui",
                       ifelse(user == "unguided","pri","All"))) 

slope <- format_numbers(slope)

slope <- slope %>%
  mutate(r_lo95 = ifelse(as.numeric(gsub(",", "", r_lo95)) <= 10,
                         round(as.numeric(r_lo95),0),
                         r_lo95),
         #r_hi95 = round(as.numeric(r_hi95),0),
         rm_lo95 = ifelse(as.numeric(gsub(",", "", rm_lo95)) <= 10,
                         round(as.numeric(rm_lo95),0),
                         rm_lo95),
         rm_hi95 = ifelse(as.numeric(gsub(",", "", rm_hi95)) <= 10,
                         round(as.numeric(rm_lo95),0),
                         rm_hi95),
         release_morts = round(as.numeric(release_morts),0),
         'H. 95% CI' = paste0(h_lo95, " - ", h_hi95),
         'R. 95% CI' = paste0(r_lo95, " - ", r_hi95),
         'RM. 95% CI' = paste0(rm_lo95, " - ", rm_hi95),
         'TM. 95% CI' = paste0(m_lo95, " - ", m_hi95)
         ) %>%
select(Year = year, User = user, area, region,
       Harvest_Estimates = harvests,
       Harvest_SD = sd_h,
       Harvest_CI = `H. 95% CI`,
       Release_Estimates = releases,
       Release_SD = sd_r,
       Release_CI = `R. 95% CI`,
       Rel_Mort_Rate = mort_rate,
       Mean_wt_lbs = wt,
       TM_Estimates = mort_lbs,
       TM_SD = sd_m,
       TM_CI = `TM. 95% CI`)

area_codes <- unique(slope$area)

slope %>% filter(area == "CSEO" & User != "All") %>%
  select(-region, -area)-> slope_cseo
slope %>% filter(area == "EWYKT" & User != "All") %>%
  select(-region, -area)-> slope_ewykt
slope %>% filter(area == "NSEI" & User != "All") %>%
  select(-region, -area)-> slope_nsei
slope %>% filter(area == "NSEO" & User != "All") %>%
  select(-region, -area)-> slope_nseo
slope %>% filter(area == "SSEI" & User != "All") %>%
  select(-region, -area)-> slope_ssei
slope %>% filter(area == "SSEO" & User != "All") %>%
  select(-region, -area)-> slope_sseo

AT_N <- 1
AT_N2 <- AT_N2 + 1
```
